title: Exact shift-compatible realization of the canonical projection mate
statement: In the proper Noetherian scheme setting of [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], use the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], shared derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], strong monoidal pullback F [def-pc-derived-pullback], direct image R [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and an adjunction a:F ⊣ R. Fix E in D_QCoh(O_Z). Define S(K)=K tensor R(E) and T(K)=R(F(K) tensor E). The maps eta_K=a.homEquiv(mu^{-1}_{K,R(E)} followed by F(K) tensor the counit at E) form the explicit natural transformation projectionComparisonNatTrans. There exist coherent integer-shift structures on the specified functors S and T for which both functors are triangulated and this natural transformation commutes with shifts. This asserts the diagrammatic exactness data only, without an isomorphism-locus or invertibility assertion.

source.place: Tag 08EU, proof: exactness of the two composite functors; Cohomology, equation (20.54.2.1)

proof.text: Construct the natural projection transformation on the ambient derived category, with components given by the adjunction mate of the inverse tensorator followed by the whiskered counit. Its naturality follows by homEquiv_naturality_left_square, oplax tensorator naturality in the first variable, and whisker_exchange; this construction and naturality proof are implemented without any holes.

Apply derivedPullback_tensorShift to choose compatible exact shift structures on pullback and all required tensorRight functors, natural in the fixed tensor factor and compatible with the flipped oplax tensorator. No independently fixed shift comparison is imposed on the supplied monoidal pullback.

Give direct image the right-adjoint shift a.rightAdjointCommShift. Mathlib a.commShift_of_leftAdjoint makes the adjunction compatible with these shifts, and a.isTriangulated_rightAdjoint proves direct-image exactness from pullback exactness. Composite functor instances give exactness of S and T. Identify projectionComparisonNatTrans componentwise with a.rightAdjointProjectionMap for the flipped oplax tensorator, using rightAdjointProjectionMap_app_app and μIso_inv. Apply the already proved upstream a.commShift_rightAdjointProjectionMap_app; its hypotheses are precisely compatibility of the flipped inverse tensorator and tensoring the counit, supplied by the new geometric lemma. This proves the shift square without any assumption that a projection component is invertible.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08EU exactness assertion, using a geometric tensor/pullback shift lemma and the proved upstream ProjectionMapShift theorem plus Mathlib Triangulated.Adjunction.

theorem projectionComparison_exact
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    (a : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z) :
    ∃ (s : (tensorRight ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj)).CommShift ℤ)
      (t : ((derivedPullback f ⋙ tensorRight E.obj) ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage f).CommShift ℤ),
      letI := s
      letI := t
      (tensorRight ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj)).IsTriangulated ∧
      ((derivedPullback f ⋙ tensorRight E.obj) ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage f).IsTriangulated ∧
      NatTrans.CommShift (projectionComparisonNatTrans f a E.obj) ℤ
